newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Easter helps boost Swiss March hotel stays 4.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Easter helps boost Swiss March hotel stays 4.2 pct.

text.p: Overnight stays in Swiss hotels rose 4.2 percent in March from the year-earlier month to 2.96 million guest-nights, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Easter holidays fell primarily in March 1997, it noted, whereas they were entirely in April the year before.
The total was 3.9 percent below the March average for the past five years and 9.2 percent below the 10-year average.
Guest-nights in the first quarter of 1997 rose 1.9 percent to 8.04 million. Domestic guest stays were up 2.2 percent while demand from foreigners rose 1.7 percent.
